interruption.model: an explicit interruptPlan entry throws RunAbortedError BEFORE the tick executes and BEFORE its checkpoint is written — the honest model of a crash, in which work in flight is lost and only checkpointed ticks survive

checkpointIdentity.derivesFrom: (runId, tickIndex, taskRef) — NEVER the attempt counter
checkpointIdentity.consequence: a retry of the same tick cannot mint a second checkpoint identity
checkpointIdentity.conflictSemantics: a differing outcome for the same tick is CONFLICT_REJECTED, never an overwrite (INV-2 discipline applied to orchestration state)
